description: Real headline + summary rows from the live-source run (Oct 2026, 27 approved feeds); expected Funding Round Tracker outcome per row.

expected.why: SEC enforcement action: a scheme that 'raised approximately $860,000 from investors' (logged as 'Williams $860,000' before the fix)

samples.title: The Week’s 10 Biggest Funding Rounds: AI Drives A Varied Lineup Of Large Financings
samples.summary: It was another interesting week for AI-related startup funding, with a number of large rounds and quirky companies. The largest financings went to Tenstorrent, a developer of AI processors and systems, and AI lab Flapping Airplanes. The quirkiest round, meanwhile, was undoubtedly a $200 million financing for Warhound, which wants to breed elite military dogs. A number of big rounds in areas including biotech, space tech and physical AI rounded out the list.
